## Working session summary

The work is complete and pushed: **https://github.com/link-assistant/router/pull/199** (now marked ready for review).

## What landed

**One admin credential model.** The first-visitor claim — web, Telegram and VK — now mints an ordinary admin-scoped `la_sk_` JWT (`sub`, `iat`, `exp`, `label`, `scope=admin`) instead of an opaque `la_admin_…` digest.

- `src/admin.rs` — `AdminClaim` holds the `TokenManager`; the claim file stores the token *id*, never the value. The anti-bricking two-phase handshake survives because the candidate is minted **already revoked** and only reinstated on confirm. Confirming also calls `revoke_other_admin_tokens(keep_id)`, retiring the startup `bootstrap-admin` token by id (issue comment a). `rotate_with_ttl` CAS-checks the on-disk claim under the exclusive lock and swaps atomically.
- `src/proxy.rs` — `authenticate_client` short-circuits on an admin credential before `validate_token`, so `scope=admin` is a superset of client access (issue comment b: `/v1/models` no longer 401s for an admin credential).
- `src/admin_api.rs` — optional `{"ttl_hours": n}` on bootstrap and rotate; `require_admin` delegates to the same rule both ports use.
- Migration: legacy `la_admin_…` claims keep working, `doctor` warns, first rotate converts to a JWT.

**Tests** (all green locally — 428 lib tests plus every integration suite, 0 failures): `src/admin_tests.rs::jwt_model`, new HTTP-level coverage in `tests/admin_ui_test.rs` (persistent store + restart harness: claim shape, TTL, bootstrap retirement, restart persistence, atomic rotation across restart, expiry), `tests/chat_admin_test.rs` (chat claim yields a JWT, cross-channel exclusion), and `tests/router_e2e/cases_regressions.rs::an_admin_credential_both_manages_tokens_and_reaches_the_models`.

Docs (README admin-access, chat-bot use case), a `changelog.d` fragment (`bump: minor`; the release workflow does the version bump), the `la_sk_…` sign-in placeholder with `ui/dist` rebuilt, and the coverage baseline update CI asked for are all included.

## One thing to flag

The first CI run failed on clippy 1.97's `some_filter` lint (my local toolchain is 1.96) and on the coverage baseline; both are fixed in `f0f45c0`. **GitHub Actions has not created a run for the branch since 19:34 UTC** — pushing `f0f45c0`, adding a label, and pushing an empty commit (`78e6d26`) all produced no run, and no run has been created repo-wide since 20:09 UTC, so this looks like a stalled Actions queue rather than something about this PR. CI on the final commit is therefore **not yet verified**; locally `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features` and the full test suite are clean. The empty `chore: re-run CI` commit can be squashed on merge.
